name: ThaiSafetyBench
description: An open-source benchmark comprising 1,954 malicious prompts in Thai, designed to assess large language model safety in Thai cultural and social contexts, including culturally grounded harmful prompts.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the Thai safety research community, with growing interest due to its culturally grounded focus but not yet broad mainstream adoption.
notes: Includes a fine-tuned harmful response classifier and a leaderboard for continuous evaluation; highlights vulnerabilities in safety alignment for Thai-specific attacks.
